witnesses.separates: Three 4 cells at three corners of a 1x2 box: $RectMarker reads them as a marker and draws a copy past its empty corner (11, 9); the concept, which reads only 2-apart square boxes, leaves them as they are.

Every marker spans a box whose corners are 3 apart: $DerivedStride derives stride 3 and draws a copy at the marker whose empty corner is (12, 5); the concept, at stride 2, finds no marker and so no template marker, and is undefined.

A 1x7 template, with 4 cells of different markers on shared lines: at bounds 6 and above, cells of three markers form further rectangle triples, so RectMarker is undefined; the concept copies the template at the two other markers.

A template that is not symmetric about the diagonal through its marker's empty corner, and a marker whose empty corner (6, 10) is the top-right one: the concept mirrors the template across rows, and $Rotate turns it a quarter turn.
The template is drawn in 3: $AnyColorTemplate copies it in 3 at (11, 10); the concept, reading color 2, finds no template and is undefined.
The template holds 2 and 3 cells: $AnyColorTemplate copies both colors, and the concept copies only the 2 cells.
The markers are drawn in 3: $DerivedMarkerColor derives marker color 3 and draws a copy at (11, 10); the concept, reading color 4, finds no marker and is undefined.

The copies at (7, 5) and (5, 7) each cover a cell of the other's marker, (7, 7) and (5, 5), at a background cell of the template: the concept keeps those 4 cells, and $BoxStamp writes background over them.

The copy at the marker whose empty corner is (1, 11) runs one row past the top edge, and a 4 cell of each marker shares a row with the other: the concept draws the rows inside the grid; at bounds 6 and above the two markers' cells form further rectangle triples, so $RectMarker is undefined.
`bg=DominantColor` from the stored value: train 0 with 0 and 1 swapped
`marker_stride=TileCount` from the stored value: the input of `stride-three`
`marker_max_side=SepTileCount` from the stored value: the input of `copy-past-edge`
`template_color=RarestColor` from the stored value: train 0 with 2 and 1 swapped

Markers whose corners are 3 apart, with rows 5 and 11 and columns 5 and 11 empty: the separator tiling gives 3, so marker_stride=SepTileCount reads the markers and copies the template; at the stored stride 2 the concept finds no marker and is undefined.

On an 11x11 grid, a 4 cell of the template's marker forms a second rectangle triple with a cell 8 columns away: at the stored bounds 2..8 the bound 8 splits the 4 cells inexactly and RectMarker is undefined; TileCount gives the bounds 2, 3, 4 and 6, at which every reading agrees.

Beside the 4 markers, three 3 cells sit at three corners of a 2-apart box: with the admitted colors read from the input, 3 and 4 both split exactly into marker triples and $DerivedMarkerColor is undefined; with the stored colors 2 and 4, it reads the 4 markers as the concept does.

The input of copy-past-edge, with the bound on a marker's sides set to 2 alone: $RectMarker reads the two markers and copies the template; with the bounds TileCount gives, which reach 7, the cells of the two markers also form a rectangle triple and the case is undefined.

On an 11x11 grid with ink on every candidate separator line, 4 cells of different markers form rectangle triples at bound 8: the bounds TileCount gives, 2, 3, 4 and 6, read the stride-2 markers and copy the template; SepTileCount finds no separator tiling, so its case is undefined, and so is $RectMarker at the stored bounds.

Train 0 with 2 and 4 swapped and the template color set to 4: $DerivedMarkerColor reads the 2 triples as markers and copies the 4 template; the concept reads 4 as both colors, finds no marker, and is undefined.

A 5x5 template that outnumbers the background and no other marker: at the stored background $AnyColorTemplate copies nothing and returns the input; with bg=DominantColor the background is read as 2, the template as the 0 cells, and the case is undefined.

A line of five 3 cells beside a three-cell template of 2: template_color=RarestColor reads the 2 cells as the template and copies them as the concept does; $AnyColorTemplate takes the 3 cells into the template, whose box then has no marker at its corner, and is undefined.

Stride-3 markers on a separator tiling of three segments, and one stride-2 triple on the tiling's middle lines: marker_stride=SepTileCount reads stride 3 alone and copies the template; TileCount gives strides 2 to 6, whose readings disagree, and is undefined.

Three stride-2 markers whose outer cells also form a stride-4 triple: the stored stride and DerivedStride read the stride-2 markers and copy the template; TileCount gives strides 2 to 5, whose readings disagree, and is undefined.
